claim_boundary: This compact capsule retains the verified protocol, summary, report, and full-run manifest. Re-evaluation still requires the checkpoints listed by that manifest. Development results are not external validation.

content.advancement_rule: continuous multiscale beats continuous graph OOD mean position RMSE by >=5% on every seed, ID regression <=5% on every seed

analytic_baselines.constant_velocity: advances velocity with no forces or contacts
analytic_baselines.force_kinematic: uses force/mass with no contacts, walls, or drag

limits: known object states, no learned visual perception
fixed training budget is equal updates, not equal wall-clock or FLOPs
parameter matching uses nearest width; actual errors are reported
no claim of physical rotation equivariance or compute-adaptive execution
content.selection: minimum validation position RMSE + 0.25 * velocity RMSE
content.test_policy: test splits used only after all training and validation selection
content.training: same scenes, updates, sampler seeds and fixed objective weights
content.uncertainty: initialization/minibatch seeds on one fixed dataset; not population inference

# RIPII world-model benchmark

Decision: **no_advance**. Development evidence only.

Checkpoint selection used validation only. Values are position RMSE mean ± sample standard deviation across initialization seeds.

| Model | In distribution | More objects | Held-out properties | Faster motion |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| graph_continuous | 0.0904 ± 0.0075 | 0.1164 ± 0.0057 | 0.1203 ± 0.0058 | 0.1755 ± 0.0254 |
| global_pool_continuous | 0.0920 ± 0.0070 | 0.1235 ± 0.0056 | 0.1325 ± 0.0054 | 0.2167 ± 0.0262 |
| multiscale_continuous | 0.0983 ± 0.0097 | 0.1216 ± 0.0033 | 0.1301 ± 0.0074 | 0.2130 ± 0.0275 |
